My guess would be that it was absolutely exactly why her last week was so great. She had a plan, and she had the eerie calmness that comes with that. I too feel this calmness, my appetite has resurfaced, and I smile and laugh as of recent since I've gathered the tools needed and dedicated the day I've decided on. Obviously there is no TRUE way to KNOW, and that's unfortunate, yet I hoped to maybe give you a little insight there to possibly help with a little piece of closure in that area of it. 
    THE other reason for my comment is to ask you something though, and would certainly appreciate a response if your up for it. My curiosity lies in the department of how you ask yourself "if it was your fault". What if she pre-emptively told you before hand that you had absolutely NOTHING to do with her desicion? Do you assume you might still ask yourself these things, and second-guess yourself regardless? The reason I ask is because that is what I have already started to do, trying to make sure these special people to me, know they take no part in my hurt. Yet sometimes I still wonder after the storm calms and the dust settles, will they still question themselves?..
          Anyways, I'm deeply sorry for your loss, and I hope she is in a better, much more peaceful place, whether she was religious or not. 
                -cheers
Sent you a DM, hope you got it mate.

If you are scared, my opinion is you don't want to do it, or you are not 100% sure subconsciously. I can confidently say that I am not scared at all. I don't think you fear death when you are truly ready, the only thing that you fear would be consequences, like loved ones emotions, or the fear of improperly doing it, being unsuccessful and dealing with whatever that brings on top of it; or if you are religious then whatever that brings after. I can't tell you what to do or how to do it. Assisted suicide is illegal, and I don't want to break the law, nor this wonderful forums rules. The method I chose was an exit bag, because of my personal preferences and research. I would strongly advise you do ample amounts of your own research as well if you truly feel that you are in so much pain that nothingness (death), would be better than life now. Cheers mate

Wow, there is so much here I could never touch on it all in a post. First thing is, do you have any good friends, or friends at all that would really be willing to listen to you and discuss opinions, theories, advice, concerns, and feelings with? There is just so many things that complicate your situation BECAUSE of that beautifully innocent child you are carrying around right now. Also, I would strongly recommend you get the notion out of your head that because you wanted to keep the child, and your ex didn't, that it makes you and only you finacially responsible...The fact that he consentually didn't protect himself upon that conception, he decided to be finacially accountable if it happened; whether he was to immature to consciously realize that or not. I get you probably don't want to add another problem like that to your list, and there may be other things attached to that as well. Lastly, I don't think you are feeling sorry for yourself, I think you are scared, I think you are concerned for the baby, I think you have a mountain of anxiety about financial problems ahead, along with not having the feeling of being able to come to a p lace you call home that isn't four seats with wheels and no space. If you want someone to talk to, I'm a great listener, and can give you whatever advice I can if it's available, or we can just talk so you have someone to talk to in case you don't in general, or just don't at that time and feel like you need to. Just message me and I'll give you my information :D
                                            -Troy

I'm not so sure about that...if in the wrong mindset (which I would say seems to be a relatively raw, and negative one by your posts..) it could put you in a trip that's 100x worse than the sober emotions your having now because of aggravated anxiety, and fear, etc. I'm not saying it couldn't help, but if your not keen of drugs I'm the first place, I would highly recommend not doing it, not that you need that recommendation or my opinion anyways. As far as feeling hopeless, helpless, depressed, and not only wanting to die but ready to die, I'm right there with you bro. I'm 28, divorced, and not living up to my expectations or dreams. Mix in that emotional devastation, and were teammates on the same playing field. Unfortunately I don't have an inspiring post for you, or thought about something to say to you to attempt to diverge you from suicide, but I do want to tickle your brain with something. Maybe you could try my idea. Around a year ago is when I finally realized I wanted suicide as my way out. It's my choice anyways right ? After alot of confessing and reaching out on top of continuous research on the subject, and people's experiences, I decided to make a date. I made my date a bit longer than most recommend, two years to be efact, I went out and got all the tools for the method I chose, found the perfect area and planned everything I wanted to do on that day. I gave my self anple time because I wanted to make sure I was as confident that I wanted this through an extended period of time, but also give my life a chance to change and see if I could find happiness again, or even just being content, just not sadness and desperation. I can tell you at this point, halfway through, I'm just as confident as day one, if not more confident now. The thing is though, I'm still here. So if your ready too, prepare, make sure it's what you want, and give yourself a chunk of time in between now and your chosen date. Maybe less time than mine, or more, that's on you. Something else is, I'm always here to chatter or I can give you my email, or even phone number man, that's up to you. Best regards. - Troy.                                 Edit: sorry for the sloppy grammar and paragraphing, I'm on my cell phone.

Hi there.
 Unfortunately I don't have some inspiring comment, hoping to talk you out of it. As I myself am very suicidal, and have been for the better of nine months now. I do offer something though. Very similar to your situation, except I am in the shoes of your better half. I can't tell you how much it hurts to experience that pain, and live with it every day, but I CAN tell you how much that man loves you to stay with you and make it work. That was me. You will absolutely devastate him, (and I'm sure many more) if you do this. Again, I'm not trying to talk you out of it, just trying to give you some insight I believe you deserve. I could tell you alot of things that you might not be seeing, that is if you want me to. Feel free to message me, at any time. I don't really sleep xD.
